CREATE TABLE public.formation (
    description text,
    id_formation text NOT NULL,
    jour_semaine integer NOT NULL,
    nom text NOT NULL,
    heure_debut time without time zone NOT NULL,
    heure_fin time without time zone NOT NULL,
    chemins_images text[],
    CONSTRAINT check_jour_semaine CHECK (((jour_semaine <= 6) AND (jour_semaine >= 0))),
    CONSTRAINT Formation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id_formation),
    CONSTRAINT check_periode CHECK ((heure_debut < heure_fin)) NOT VALID
);

CREATE TABLE public.formation_instance (
    id_formation_instance text NOT NULL,
    id_reference_formation text NOT NULL,
    jour date NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT formation_instance_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id_formation_instance),
    CONSTRAINT check_formation_instance CHECK ((id_formation_instance ~ '^formation_instance[1-9][0-9]*$'::text)) NOT VALID
);

CREATE TABLE public.reservation (
    prenom text NOT NULL,
    courriel text NOT NULL,
    telephone bigint,
    nom text NOT NULL,
    id_reservation text NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT verification_ID CHECK ((id_reservation ~ '^reservation[1-9][0-9]*$'::text)),
    CONSTRAINT courriel_check CHECK ((courriel ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'::text)),
    CONSTRAINT Reservation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id_reservation),
    CONSTRAINT telephone_check CHECK (((telephone >= 0) AND (telephone <= '99999999999'::bigint)))
);
